ios.desc:
Stop Retyping. Start Expanding.
  Type a shortcut, get your full text—instantly, in any app.

  ◉ HOW IT WORKS

  ▶ Type "sig" → your full email signature appears
  ▶ Type "addr" → your complete address expands
  ▶ Type "thx" → your thank-you template fills in
  ▶ Works in Mail, Slack, Messages, Safari—anywhere you type

  ◉ SMART TEMPLATES

  ▶ Add today's date, counters, or fill-in-the-blank fields
  ▶ Build reusable replies, code snippets, or form responses
  ▶ Organize with folders and drag-and-drop

  ◉ CUSTOM KEYBOARD

  ▶ Access your entire snippet library without leaving your app
  ▶ Search and paste in seconds
  ▶ Clipboard history at your fingertips

  ◉ SYNC & COLLABORATE

  ▶ Sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
  ▶ Share workspaces with your team
  ▶ Everything backed up securely

  ◉ FEEDBACK & SUPPORT:

  ▶ Have feedback or suggestions? Contact us at info.copynote@gmail.com  
  ▶ Terms of Use: https://copynote.net/terms-of-service  
  ▶ Privacy Policy: https://copynote.net/privacy-policy

show_hn.title: Show HN: I created text expander/text blaze but for iOS app

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

I use the text expander for my work all the time but It always bothered me that they don't have mobile apps. I wanted to copy and paste notes/templates from the keyboard.

So, I created a side project, CopyNote.

I would appreciate any feedback on it.

I hope you'll enjoy using the iOS app.

Cheers!
